chunks: And let those who do not believe in the Hereafter incline towards it, and be pleased with it, and gain what they are gaining.

key_terms.يَقْتَرِفُوا: they gain / they acquire / they commit

ai.seo_question: Why do the disbelievers incline towards the Quran according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse elucidates the psychological state of the disbelievers whose hearts are drawn to the Quran not for spiritual guidance, but due to their denial of the Hereafter, which makes them treat the revelation as a temporal commodity. This inclination reflects a worldly attachment where they accumulate its words for prestige or utility, mirroring the broader theme of divine wisdom in granting ease to those who reject eternal accountability.
